meta.title: {name}: add it to Chrome
meta.description: TwoTicks is a free panel for WhatsApp Web with a privacy screen, unanswered chats, quick replies, a scheduler and more. Add it to Google Chrome from the Chrome Web Store in four steps.
nav.label: Sections
hero.note: Free, with no account. For Google Chrome {minChrome} or newer on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS.
store.name: Chrome Web Store
install.title: Install in four steps
install.intro: TwoTicks is in the {store}. Chrome adds it with a click and keeps it up to date by itself.
install.allDone: All ticks are blue: TwoTicks is installed.
step1.title: Open TwoTicks in the {store}
step1.text: On TwoTicks' page in the store, click {addToChrome}.
step2.title: Confirm in Chrome
step2.text: Chrome asks {addTitle} and shows what TwoTicks may access. Click {addExtension}.
step3.title: Pin it to the toolbar
step3.text: Click the puzzle piece icon in Chrome's toolbar and choose {pin} next to TwoTicks, so its icon stays in view.
step4.title: Open WhatsApp Web
notice.oldChrome: This Chrome is version {version}. TwoTicks needs version {minChrome} or newer, so update Chrome first.
notice.otherChromium: You are using {browser}. TwoTicks is made and tested for Google Chrome; other browsers built on Chromium can often add it from the {store} as well.
notice.notChromium: TwoTicks runs in Google Chrome. Open this page in Chrome on your computer to install it.
notice.mobile: TwoTicks runs in Chrome on a computer, next to WhatsApp Web. Open this page there to install it.
features.title: What TwoTicks adds to WhatsApp Web
shot.privacy: {tool} off and on, side by side. With it on, names and messages are blurred, and only the message under the pointer can be read.
shot.unanswered: {tool}: three chats that are waiting for a reply, and three suggested answers for one of them.
shot.quickReplies: {tool} in a chat with Emma Wilson: saved answers about opening hours, the address and delivery, with her first name filled in.
shot.ai: Before an AI request, TwoTicks shows exactly what will be sent to the chosen AI service and waits for your confirmation.
shot.export: {tool}: three selected chats, ready to download as JSON and TXT files in one ZIP file.
video.title: A day with TwoTicks
video.note: The film loads from YouTube only when you press play.
faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.privacy.q: Does TwoTicks read or send my chats?
faq.update.q: How does TwoTicks get new versions?
faq.update.a: Chrome updates it by itself from the {store}, usually within a few hours of a new version. Your settings, quick replies and scheduled messages stay as they are.
faq.browsers.q: Which browsers and computers does TwoTicks run on?
faq.browsers.a: Google Chrome {minChrome} or newer on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS. Chrome on phones and tablets has no extensions. Other browsers built on Chromium, such as Microsoft Edge, can often add extensions from the {store} as well, but TwoTicks is made and tested for Google Chrome.
faq.blocked.q: Chrome does not let me add TwoTicks
faq.blocked.a: If the button in the store is greyed out, or Chrome says that your administrator has blocked the extension, an organisation manages this Chrome. Ask whoever manages the computer.
faq.remove.a: Right-click the TwoTicks icon in Chrome's toolbar and choose {removeFromChrome}. You can also open {address} and click {remove} on the TwoTicks card.
footer.publisher: TwoTicks is published by {publisher}, a private individual in Vienna, Austria.
footer.page: This page sets no cookies and has no analytics. The film loads from YouTube only when you press play.
